description:
## Destination

The published catalog results use fair baselines and live in one place, and a first user (or their agent) has the rules and patterns to write, test and call a kernel. Charted 2026-10-15 after the 0.1.0 readiness check (defk-wfi).

## Steps

- defk-l2g: Myers bit-parallel Levenshtein in both fuzzy_search backends. The only open ticket where a published verdict is likely too favourable to defk.
- defk-djy.18: usage-rules.md for kernel authors and their agents.
- defk-vcx.1: guide section: call a kernel only above a size, with an Elixir clause below it.
- defk-9p6.31: one source for the catalog results (the scoreboard snapshot). After defk-l2g, so the fuzzy_search numbers change once.

```mermaid
graph LR
    l2g[defk-l2g] --> r31[defk-9p6.31]
    djy18[defk-djy.18]
    vcx1[defk-vcx.1]
```

## Out of scope

- Publishing on Hex (the user's call; the user leans to publishing after defk-l2g).
- The per-call cost work (defk-25s): a separate measurement map after this one.
- The deferred exploration epics.

Done when the four tickets are closed and mix ci is green on main.
title: Map: honest results and first-user docs around 0.1.0
